title: We built a tool that scans 20,000+ stocks so traders don't have to check charts manually
author: MonitorSuspicious86
selftext:
I got tired of spending hours opening charts just to find a few stocks worth watching.  
  
So I built StockBot.  
  
It scans 20,000+ stocks and ETFs across 38 markets and filters potential setups using technical analysis.  
  
You get the direction, setup score, risk levels and reasons behind each signal—all in one place.  
  
If you trade stocks or ETFs and want to spend less time searching:  
  
[https://stockbot.online](https://stockbot.online/)  
Telegram: /Incurablestock\_bot
